descriptionChirho: The proper noun Tyre (Greek Τύρος), the ancient Phoenician coastal city, referenced in prophetic judgments and Jesus' ministry. All grammatical cases (accusative, dative, genitive) and minor spelling variants refer to the same geographical location. Consistently rendered across languages: Spanish 'Týros/Tiro,' Arabic 'صورَ/صُورَ,' Hindi 'सूर/तूरुस/त्यरोस,' Korean '두로,' Swahili 'Týros/Tiro.' The variation in Hindi and Greek forms represents transliteration differences, not distinct referents.
